title: The Alchemist
author: Paulo Coelho
quote: The secret of life, though, is to fall seven times and to get up eight times.

title: The Giver
author: Lois Lowry
quote: We gained control of many things. But we had to let go of others.

title: The Seven Husbands of Evelyn Hugo
author: Taylor Jenkins Reid
quote: Never let anyone make you feel ordinary.

title: The Miraculous Journey of Edward Tulane
author: Kate DiCamillo
quote: If you have no intention of loving or being loved, the whole journey is pointless.

title: Never Let Me Go
author: Kazuo Ishiguro
quote: Memories, even your most precious ones, fade surprisingly quickly.

title: Pachinko
author: Min Jin Lee
quote: Living every day in the presence of those who refuse to acknowledge your humanity takes great courage.

title: The Art of Thinking Clearly
author: Rolf Dobelli
quote: We prefer a simple lie to a complex truth.

title: One Of Us Is Lying
author: Karen M. McManus
quote: Things that break—be they bones, hearts, or promises—can be put back together again.

title: The Hate U Give
author: Angie Thomas
quote: What's the point of having a voice if you're going to be silent in those moments you shouldn't be?
